title: Hospital IT Strategy
background: A hospital system needs to modernize IT while supporting clinical operations and compliance.
candidate_prompt: How would you evaluate the situation and recommend what the organization should do next?
good_answer_includes: Assesses current systems against business goals
Identifies capability gaps and technical risks
Prioritizes technology investments by value and feasibility
great_answer_includes: Balances modernization with cost and disruption
Considers build, buy, and partner options
Links technology choices to business outcomes
interviewer_notes: A strong candidate should use a clear technology strategy structure, isolate the most important drivers, and connect the recommendation to business impact.
